Breast Implant Augmentation Mammaplasty
Before and After Gallery

When viewing our photo gallery, you will notice that specific breast implant brands, sizes, shapes, or profiles are not listed. This is because each individual’s results are influenced by their unique body characteristics, and the same implant can look different on different people. Factors such as chest wall width, body frame, skin quality, and the size and shape of the breasts prior to surgery
all play a role in the final appearance. The photographs are provided for general educational purposes only and do not
guarantee that you will achieve the same outcome. Dr Konrat recommends booking a thorough consultation and a breast implant sizing session, where different options can be tried on to help you gain a more personalised understanding of how implants may appear on your body. A second opinion with an appropriately experienced and qualified Doctor is recommended.

Breast augmentation, often referred to as breast implant surgery, is one of the most frequently performed cosmetic procedures in Australia. It involves more than simply increasing breast size – careful consideration is given to proportions, tissue quality, and overall balance.

Every patient is different. Factors such as chest width, breast shape and dimensions, skin quality, nipple position, and existing breast tissue all influence which type of implant may be most suitable. At Brisbane Cosmetic Clinic, these individual details are carefully assessed to help guide decisions about treatment options.

Surgical outcomes vary from person to person, and as with all procedures, there are risks that must be discussed before making a decision. For further details, please visit our dedicated Breast Augmentation Page or arrange a consultation with Dr Georgina Konrat.

We sincerely thank the patients who have given permission for their before and after images to be displayed in this gallery.

Please note: this gallery contains clinical images of breast augmentation before and after surgery. These photographs are provided for educational purposes only and are intended to demonstrate some of the possible outcomes.

Important information about these photographs

The before and after photographs in this gallery show the results of surgery performed by Dr Georgina Konrat, and are published with the consent of the patients shown. Individual results vary from person to person, and these images are not a guarantee that you will achieve a similar outcome. Every patient’s anatomy, healing and circumstances are different. All surgery carries risks, which are discussed in detail during your consultation and in your pre and post-operative information.
